scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:workspace && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:packages && pnpm run lint:api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && node --test scripts/foundation/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @vocanova/api-client test && pnpm --filter @vocanova/web test:middleware && pnpm run test:api
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:api
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.js apps/web packages scripts/foundation docs/development.md infra/README.md && node scripts/foundation/check-go-format.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.js apps/web packages scripts/foundation docs/development.md infra/README.md && cd apps/api && gofmt -w .
